workload: 64 individual public Fs workspace writes to unique small files, fresh local store per run, full-flush durability, read verification after timing
method: Identical bench-fs source and local-runner feature applied to detached baseline worktree; three warm runs per revision, alternating revisions on each host; elapsed time excludes build and read verification
limits: A single small-file workload on shared machines; Windows and WSL ran concurrently for two pairs. The gate now records all four durability/batching modes, but this revision comparison covers only full-flush individual writes. CPU, memory, and allocations were not recorded.
